scope: One-hour targeted follow-up of leptotene mismatch: reference-gene universe, bulk-count length sensitivity, and author-labelled independent UMI profiles. Exploratory follow-up, not untouched confirmatory validation.
prior_work: Preserve all seven prior snapshots and their bound sources/specifications. Store new work under results/reference_limits and reference_limits_snapshot.
sources: Cached GSE112393 full germ centroid XLSX and full pooled four-class reference
Cached P15 EmptyDrops complete-library prepared profiles
Cached GSE155967 six RNA profiles and GSE83264 four sorted comparator profiles
Cached Ensembl 79 GRCm38 GTF as explicit length-sensitivity annotation, not asserted original counting GTF
GSE107644 primary article PMC6123400, supplementary per-cell stage table and official UMI files if identities reconcile
PMC10541148 data availability only as a targeted alternative-source audit
before_fit_rules: No gene is chosen based on improved L/Z fit or target marker expression. Reconstruct full valid Green centroids from their original table and use deterministic intersections.
Compare legacy vs expanded reference gene universes, and standard inverse-sqrt-centroid-4 vs uniform gene weights. All models within each comparison use identical genes and target normalization.
Keep old gene-fold assignments for legacy genes at seed 20261024; append expanded genes in sorted order with seed 20261025. Gene folds are not biological replication.

For mm10 GSE155967 bulk counts only, compare uncorrected counts with counts divided by frozen Ensembl 79 union-exon gene length on identical length-covered genes. This is a generic annotation sensitivity, not validated TPM or original processing reproduction. Do not divide UMI profiles by gene length.
Record altered normalization and expression coverage when the gene universe changes; do not directly rank cross-universe RMSE as if target values were unchanged.
Inspect all eligible full-P15 author groups and both RNA-sum/equal-cell views, not only favourable L/Z profiles. Retain all ten prior sorted profiles, with preleptotene unscored.

For GSE107644, use explicit author cell IDs, stage and QC labels; barcode table alone is insufficient. Require matrix-cell and library identities, integer UMI semantics, and source gene mapping to reconcile. Exclude explicit mutant samples; do not infer stage or genotype from expression.

If a stage-defined candidate reference is built, use unmodified stage means from the independent source without target-driven marker selection. Evaluate all prespecified P15 types and sorted profiles, label this as exploratory cross-study transfer, and report condition numbers, fine component weights and held-out gene errors. No calibrated cell-number claims.
Do not treat synchronization, stage-sorted cell counts, processing views or genes as independent animals. Keep age, technology, purity and genotype evidence limitations explicit.
retrieval_adjustment_before_UMI_fits: Publisher TLS failures and PMC attachment HTML responses require the documented Europe PMC supplementaryFiles ZIP endpoint; allow up to 64 MiB for this single original-paper bundle instead of 32 MiB. Validate ZIP and selected workbook signatures; keep failed HTML responses excluded.
cell_ID_reconciliation_before_UMI_fits: Forty-three S1/S2 cells use the literal SpSC24_In or SpSC34_In prefix, while source barcode/matrix headers use SpSC24_ln or SpSC34_ln. Permit only these two explicit I/l aliases with the same library and cell suffix, unique barcode mapping, and independently matching per-cell author UMI total and detected-gene count. Preserve both IDs and alias flag; otherwise stop. Stage comes exclusively from Table S2.
candidate_reference_design_before_transf: Compare Green13, Green13+ChenL, Green13+ChenZ, Green13+ChenLZ and Green13+ChenBS (same-source spermatogonial representation control). Use unmodified complete author stage profiles, both equal-cell-mean and RNA-sum prototype views, fixed common genes, and both prespecified inverse-sqrt and uniform weights. Candidate evaluation excludes Chen source profiles entirely and retains all 40 prior P15/sorted profiles, with PreL unscored. These previously observed external sources are exploratory transfer checks, not an untouched final validation.
secondary_training_only_feature_panel_be: After limited all-gene prototype transfer, evaluate one fixed panel: top 200 specificity-ranked genes per each of the 20 complete Chen stage means with source CPM >=10, plus top 200 Green somatic-specific genes with source CPM >=10. Specificity is source component / summed source components, ties broken by gene symbol. Use the same union for all five candidate models, never target labels or target expression to rank genes, no tuning panel size. Preserve full common-gene response normalization and predict held-out genes across the full response universe; fit only training-fold panel genes. Report this as a secondary exploratory analysis, including negative outcomes.
source_library_stability_before_loo_fits: Retain separate L/Z/BS stage-by-library sums and equal-cell means. Assess prototype sensitivity to leaving each source library out; a retained set below 20 cells is explicitly low-N sensitivity only, never independent animal validation or a selected production reference.
secondary_prior_sorted_recheck_before_fi: Re-evaluate all 20 previously frozen sorted WT profiles from GSE158471, GSE232415 and GSE290629 in a separate gene-coverage-controlled branch. Use the same five equal-cell prototype candidates, both fixed gene weightings and all-gene/source-marker fits; preL remains unscored. Do not pick the best result or call these previously inspected sources an untouched test set. Original source hashes must match reference_audit_snapshot/design.json.
retrieval_type: Targeted lookup of explicitly named primary-source records and bulk matrix/annotation files, not exhaustive API retrieval of individual genes or cells.
